name: Arènes de Nîmes
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Roman amphitheatre with sixty genuine open arcades on each of two complete elliptical tiers, engaged columns, continuous cornices and an open stepped seating bowl. Ellipse follows mapped antipodal control points; bay intervals use equal perimeter spacing. Individual arch and cornice dimensions are simplified from exterior photos, not a masonry survey. Temporary event equipment, fencing and all lettering omitted. Dossier suggestions showing Rome, Pula and Verona were explicitly rejected. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
